exposure: elective single morula transfer (eSMT) on Day 4
double cleavage-stage embryo transfer (DCT) on Day 3
cohort: The study included patients aged <= 35 years undergoing in vitro fertilization (IVF), with 156 matched cases per group.
finding: Day 4 single morula transfer yielded clinical pregnancy rates comparable to Day 3 double cleavage-stage embryo transfer while significantly reducing twin pregnancy and preterm labor risks.
mod_finding: No significant differences were observed in cesarean section rates between the elective single morula transfer and double cleavage-stage embryo transfer groups.
